stock: Options up to 10-15LT/B (1977–79 brochures; standard with the 1978 Macho package)

max_tire.note: The usual size on BaT trucks whose listings mention no lift. Some run 32x11.50 (a 1978 Top Hand) or even 33x12.50 (a 1978 Trail Duster). On a later Ramcharger with the same Dana 44 and leaf layout, 32x11.50s rubbed at full articulation.
Off-Road.com advice for a later Ramcharger on the same axle and spring layout. A 4 in lift is suggested if you want to keep the flex.
The maximum Tuff Country recommends with its 4 in EZ-Ride kit (front springs, rear add-a-leafs and 2 in blocks, plus a steering block).
A 1974 4-speed sold on BaT with Skyjacker leaves, Fox shocks and 17 in beadlocks. Crossover steering is worth considering at this height.

items.title: Steering column misassembled, steering wheel indexed 180° off
items.summary: The master serration could be 180 degrees out, and tie-rod adjustments made to compensate could leave too little thread engagement. Dealers replaced the lower steering shaft and checked the tie rods.

items.title: Intermediate steering shaft pot coupling may not tighten
items.summary: A mismatched coupling with an oversized serration might not clamp properly onto the gear or shaft splines. Dealers inspected it and replaced the coupling if necessary.

items.title: Rear step bumper may not protect the fuel tank in a rear impact
items.summary: Trucks didn't meet the FMVSS 301 fuel-system integrity impact test, so fuel could leak in a rear collision. The remedy was a free fuel-tank skid plate.

timeline.change: Ramcharger and Plymouth Trail Duster launch on a 106 in wheelbase, 4x4 only, with full-time NP203 four-wheel drive and V8 power. The top was optional, as was the passenger seat. Trucks built before June 10, 1974 have half doors whose window frames are part of the roof.
Two-wheel-drive AD100 and the 225 slant six added. Revised instrument panel. Front discs and full-time 4WD are now standard across Dodge's 4x4 range. A Ramcharger wins the Sno*Drift rally.
A grease fitting is added to the full-time front hub bearings, which had been sealed for life. This is the last year the passenger seat is optional.

New grille with rectangular parking lamps. The brochure lists electronic ignition on every engine. Engines run from the 225 to the 440, which is 4x4-only. Mid-year, the Dana 44 front axle changes to a new inner axle seal (QU40055 to QU40159).

Ramcharger Four by Four with the Macho package, and Top Hand trucks. New Hurst transfer-case lever, three-passenger front bench and trailer-towing packages up to 6,000 lb. The slant six gets a two-barrel carburetor. Last year for the 400 and 440.
Two steering recalls: a misindexed steering column (77V176) and an intermediate-shaft pot coupling that might not tighten (78V038).

New hood, grille and headlights, with four rectangular headlamps on the upper trims. The 318 becomes standard on the AW100 and the 360 is the option. The six is limited to the 2WD model. The 360 is rated at 160 hp.
Four-wheel drive switches to part-time with the chain-drive NP208. Grille openings are painted black. Last year of the removable top.
NHTSA campaign 84V115 adds a fuel-tank skid plate because the rear step bumper failed the FMVSS 301 impact test.
The second-generation Ramcharger arrives with a welded-on steel roof and a fiberglass liftgate. This is the Trail Duster's final year.

identify.intro: Seven model years and two badges, and many trucks have since been re-engined or converted. The details below help you work out what a truck actually is.

items.head: First gen vs second gen
items.body: 1974–80 trucks have a removable steel top, or none at all, on the 1972-style Dodge truck body. From 1981 the roof is welded on, the liftgate is fiberglass, and the sheet metal and dash are new (Ramcharger Central).

items.head: Year by nose
items.body: 1977–78 grilles have rectangular parking lamps. For 1979 the hood, grille and headlights are all new, with quad rectangular lamps on the upper trims and two round lamps on the lower ones. The 1980 grille openings are painted black (Ramcharger Central). Grilles swap easily, so check them against the title and the VIN.

items.head: Half doors (early 1974)
items.body: Trucks built before June 10, 1974 have doors with no frame above the glass. The window frames belong to the removable roof. Later trucks use normal pickup doors (Wikipedia).

items.head: Full-time hardware
items.body: A stock 1974–79 4x4 has the NP203 with five lever positions (Low Loc, Low, Neutral, High, High Loc) and a front axle with no locking hubs. Locking hubs, drive flanges or a different transfer case mean the drivetrain has been changed.

items.head: Chassis numbers
items.body: On BaT-listed trucks, 4x4 Dodges begin A10 and Trail Dusters AA0. The sixth character is the model-year digit. The fifth character matches the engine on those trucks: E on a 1974 318, F on 1977–78 360s and D on 1976–77 440s. Confirm with a proper decoder or the build paperwork before you trust it.

items.head: Trims and packages
items.body: SE (cloth-and-vinyl buckets, woodgrain trim and a lockable console with a removable beverage chest; from 1975 the SE dash adds volt and vacuum gauges). The 1978 Four by Four had the Macho package, with graphics, spoke or chrome wheels, 10-15LT tires and power steering. Also Top Hand, the Sno-Commander factory plow package (4x4 only) and, at Plymouth, the Trail Duster Sport.

capability.v: 24 gal (91 L) std · 35 gal (132 L) optional

capability.note: 1979 brochure, with the Sno-Commander package also 6,050 lb

capability.v: Up to 6,000 lb (2,720 kg) gross trailer weight
capability.note: 1978 brochure, with the optional heavy-duty package and a load-equalizing hitch. The standard towing package covers trailers under 2,000 lb.

values.intro: Firm and rising slowly. Clean, original trucks with paperwork bring the money, and on Bring a Trailer the Plymouth Trail Duster has recently outsold comparable Dodges.
values.note: Based on 16 Bring a Trailer sales of 1974–80 Ramchargers and Trail Dusters, December 2021 to August 2026, with a median of about $27,750. The seven Dodges sold for $15,110–26,500, and the nine Trail Dusters for $17,945–57,500. Heavily modified trucks with modern engines (a twin-turbo Trail Duster, a Cummins 6BT Ramcharger) were bid to $26,000–32,500 without selling.

production.intro: We couldn't find reliable production totals. The figures quoted online come from reader comments, not sourced references. Here are the packages the brochures and auction records document.

editions.name: SE package
editions.note: Woodgrain trim, upgraded seats and a lockable console with a removable beverage chest. From 1975 the SE dash gets volt and vacuum gauges, and there's two-tone paint (Ramcharger Central, 1978 brochure).

editions.name: Ramcharger Four by Four (Macho package)
editions.note: Bold body and tailgate decals, painted spoke or chrome disc wheels, 10-15LT-B tires and power steering on the full-time 4x4 (1978 brochure). Ramcharger Central dates the Macho Ramcharger to 1978.

editions.name: Top Hand
editions.note: Two-tone graphics and branded wheel centers. BaT has sold 1978 Top Hand trucks.

editions.name: Sno-Commander
editions.note: Factory snowplow package with a power-angling blade and power lift, 4x4 only. GVW rises to 6,050 lb on the 1979 sheet.

editions.name: Plymouth Trail Duster Sport
editions.note: Plymouth's top trim, with faux-wood trim (Motor1).

production.paint: The 1979 brochure lists colors including Sunburst Orange, Yellow Flame, Medium Canyon Red and Teal Frost Metallic. The 1978 brochure has 14, seven of them metallic. A 1978 Macho sold on BaT was in Bright Yellow Orange (DT5229), and a 1977 SE in Yellow (DT2574).
